newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-INJURED SAMMER OUT FOR THREE WEEKS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INJURED SAMMER OUT FOR THREE WEEKS.

text.p: Germany libero Matthias Sammer faces a three-week lay-off after injuring his knee in Borussia Dortmund's opening game of the season, the club said on Monday.
Dortmund said a statement Sammer, 29, underwent surgery on Monday for cartilage damage sustained in Sunday's 1-1 draw away to Hertha Berlin.
Sammer, who was substituted at half-time, looks certain to miss Germany's next World Cup qualifying game against Northern Ireland on August 20.
Injuries have plagued Sammer over the last year to the extent that he even contemplated quitting the game.
The former East German international managed to play in less than half of Dortmund's league games last season.
